feature.name: Infinite untap of creatures you control
Infinite mana creatures you control can produce

notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Goldspan Dragon.
description:
Declare Goldspan Dragon as an attacker.
Goldspan Dragon and Jolene trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}.
